metadata.audit_engine: Task 39 Final Evidence Package Engine v13.0

requirements.title: Investigation Request Submission & API Gateway Validation
requirements.srs_description: FO-1: Accept an investigation request for a transaction or customer identifier.
requirements.behavior_spec: POST /api/investigations endpoint accepts JSON payload and validates input.

requirements.title: Dynamic Planner Task Decomposition
requirements.srs_description: FO-2: Decompose the investigation into discrete, ordered reasoning tasks.
requirements.behavior_spec: Planner node constructs ordered task list based on transaction context.

requirements.title: Parallel 5-Source Evidence Retrieval
requirements.srs_description: FO-3: Retrieve customer, transaction, merchant, device, and location evidence in parallel.
requirements.behavior_spec: Parallel retrieval nodes query transaction, customer, merchant, device, and location stores.

requirements.title: Historical Fraud Pattern RAG Similarity Search
requirements.srs_description: FO-4: Compare retrieved evidence against historical fraud patterns in the knowledge base.
requirements.behavior_spec: Vector store performs embeddings similarity search against historical fraud cases.
requirements.source_snippet: def similarity_search(self, query: str, top_k: int = 2, tenant_id: str = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

requirements.title: Multi-Window Velocity Risk Calculation (5m, 1h, 24h, 7d)
requirements.srs_description: FO-5: Compute a combined risk score using rule-based and LLM-based reasoning.
requirements.behavior_spec: Velocity metrics computed across 5m, 1h, 24h, 7d windows with pure timestamp filtering.

requirements.title: Evidence Grounding Guardrail Claims Validation
requirements.srs_description: FO-6: Validate that every claim in the generated report is grounded in retrieved evidence.
requirements.behavior_spec: Guardrail validator rejects unsupported claims lacking evidence provenance citations.
requirements.source_snippet: def validate_claims(draft_explanation: str, evidence_bundle: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:

requirements.title: Bounded Critic Retry Correction Loop (Max 3 Cycles)
requirements.srs_description: FO-7: Retry failed retrieval or validation steps up to a configurable threshold.
requirements.behavior_spec: Critic node increments retry_count and re-executes up to max 3 cycles before escalation.

requirements.title: Human Escalation & HITL Review Workflow
requirements.srs_description: FO-8: Escalate to human review when confidence falls below a configurable threshold.
requirements.behavior_spec: Low confidence or ungrounded reports transition to WAITING_HUMAN status for analyst review.

requirements.title: Explainable PDF & Markdown Investigation Report Export
requirements.srs_description: FO-9: Generate a final, structured, human-readable investigation report.
requirements.behavior_spec: Generates structured PDF and Markdown reports with executive summary and citation list.

requirements.title: Immutable Audit Trail & Dead-Letter Job Retention
requirements.srs_description: FO-10: Log every node execution, tool call, and decision for audit purposes.
requirements.behavior_spec: Every state transition writes an immutable AuditLog record to database.

requirements.title: P95 Investigation Latency < 8.0s Across Concurrency Levels (1, 5, 10, 20)
requirements.srs_description: NFR-1: P95 investigation latency < 8 seconds for standard-complexity cases.
requirements.behavior_spec: Real graph execution benchmark achieves P95 < 8.0s across 1, 5, 10, 20 worker concurrency.

requirements.title: Gateway High Availability & Fault Isolation (99.9% Target)
requirements.srs_description: NFR-2: 99.9% uptime for the API gateway and orchestration layer.
requirements.behavior_spec: FastAPI gateway health check endpoint /api/health responds with 200 OK.
requirements.source_snippet: from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, BackgroundTasks, status, Query, Response, Header, UploadFile, File, Form, Request, Body

requirements.title: Horizontal Worker Queue Broker Scaling (Redis RPOPLPUSH / ACK)
requirements.srs_description: NFR-3: Support horizontal scaling of retrieval and reasoning workers via Kubernetes.
requirements.behavior_spec: DurableWorkerQueue executes atomic RPOPLPUSH, consumer LREM ACK, and strict enterprise fail-fast.

requirements.title: PII Encryption at Rest (AES-256-GCM & Legacy Fernet AES-128-CBC Compatibility)
requirements.srs_description: NFR-4: All PII must be encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM and in transit using TLS 1.2+ (with legacy Fernet AES-128-CBC decryption compatibility).
requirements.behavior_spec: Authentic AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption protects newly persisted PII; legacy Fernet decryption preserved for backward compatibility.

requirements.title: Cryptographic Tamper-Evident Audit Log Hash Chain
requirements.srs_description: NFR-5: Every investigation must produce an immutable, timestamped audit trail.
requirements.behavior_spec: AuditLog calculates SHA-256 tamper-evident entry hash chaining with previous log record.

requirements.title: 100% Provenance Citation Explainability
requirements.srs_description: NFR-6: 100% of generated claims must cite a specific evidence source.
requirements.behavior_spec: Every claim in report maps to verifiable source document or database record ID.

requirements.title: Modular Architecture & Automated Test Suite Coverage
requirements.srs_description: NFR-7: Graph nodes must be independently testable and replaceable.
requirements.behavior_spec: LangGraph node functions decoupled and testable via independent unit test harnesses.

requirements.title: AgentState Typed Dictionary Schema & Node Isolation
requirements.srs_description: SA-1: AgentState typed dictionary schema enforces node execution isolation and typing.
requirements.behavior_spec: AgentState schema enforces isolated state read/write contracts across execution nodes.

requirements.title: Dynamic Planner Task Decomposition & Allowlist Filtering
requirements.srs_description: SA-2: Dynamic Planner task decomposition and allowlist task mapping.
requirements.behavior_spec: Planner node parses transaction intent and strictly enforces approved sub-task allowlist.

requirements.title: Customer Evidence Retrieval Node & KYC Profile Extraction
requirements.srs_description: SA-3: Customer evidence retrieval node and KYC profile extraction.
requirements.behavior_spec: Queries customer model for KYC verification and risk tier status.

requirements.title: Transaction Evidence Retrieval Node & Ledger Precision
requirements.srs_description: SA-4: Transaction evidence retrieval node and ledger precision.
requirements.behavior_spec: Retrieves transaction details, amounts, currencies, and account associations.

requirements.title: Merchant Reputation Retrieval Node & Risk Score Assessment
requirements.srs_description: SA-5: Merchant reputation retrieval node and risk score assessment.
requirements.behavior_spec: Extracts merchant fraud rates, transaction categories, and merchant risk metrics.

requirements.title: Device Fingerprinting Retrieval Node & OS Profiling
requirements.srs_description: SA-6: Device fingerprinting retrieval node and OS profiling.
requirements.behavior_spec: Captures client device OS, hardware fingerprint hash, and new device flags.

requirements.title: Location Check Retrieval Node & Geo-Coordinate Validation
requirements.srs_description: SA-7: Location check retrieval node and geo-coordinate validation.
requirements.behavior_spec: Extracts geo-coordinates and country locations to detect impossible travel.

requirements.title: Evidence Verifier Node & Structured Provenance Assembly
requirements.srs_description: SA-8: Evidence verifier node aggregates sources and formats provenance records.
requirements.behavior_spec: Aggregates parallel evidence streams and attaches timestamped provenance citations.

requirements.title: Multi-Window Velocity Risk Engine (5m, 1h, 24h, 7d)
requirements.srs_description: SA-9: Multi-window transaction velocity analysis (5m, 1h, 24h, 7d).
requirements.behavior_spec: Computes rolling transaction velocities and flags sudden volume escalations.

requirements.title: Deterministic Rule Engine & Decoupled RiskSignal Synthesis
requirements.srs_description: SA-10: Deterministic rule engine evaluation and decoupled RiskSignal generation.
requirements.behavior_spec: Evaluates hard rules and generates decoupled, auditable RiskSignal objects.

requirements.title: Historical Fraud Pattern Vector Knowledge Search
requirements.srs_description: SA-11: Vector knowledge base similarity search for historical fraud patterns.
requirements.behavior_spec: Executes embedding similarity search against historical fraud precedents.

requirements.title: LLM Risk Reasoning & Multi-Factor Confidence Formulation
requirements.srs_description: SA-12: LLM-powered risk reasoning and synthesized confidence scoring.
requirements.behavior_spec: Synthesizes multidimensional evidence and computes calibrated confidence score.

requirements.title: Evidence Critic Node & Adversarial Contradiction Detection
requirements.srs_description: SA-13: Evidence critic reflection node and contradiction detection.
requirements.behavior_spec: Critiques draft reasoning against evidence bundle to detect logical contradictions.

requirements.title: Evidence Grounding Guardrail Claims Validator
requirements.srs_description: SA-14: Evidence grounding guardrail validator node for factual verification.
requirements.behavior_spec: Validates report claims against verified evidence provenance to eliminate hallucinations.

requirements.title: Human-in-the-Loop Review Escalation Dossier Generator
requirements.srs_description: SA-15: Human review escalation report generation and dossier assembly.
requirements.behavior_spec: Formats low-confidence or ungrounded investigations into structured analyst review dossiers.

requirements.title: Customer Entity Schema & KYC Verification Model
requirements.srs_description: DS-1: Customer entity schema, tenant scoping, and KYC status validation.
requirements.behavior_spec: Customer model encapsulates customer metadata, risk tier, and KYC status.

requirements.title: Account Entity Schema & Customer Foreign Key Relationship
requirements.srs_description: DS-2: Account entity schema and foreign key relationship to customer.
requirements.behavior_spec: Account model links balances and transaction histories to Customer entity.

requirements.title: Transaction Ledger Schema & Decimal Precision
requirements.srs_description: DS-3: Transaction ledger entity with decimal precision and status tracking.
requirements.behavior_spec: Transaction model preserves immutable financial amounts, currencies, and timestamps.

requirements.title: Merchant Entity Schema & Historical Fraud Profiling
requirements.srs_description: DS-4: Merchant entity schema and historical fraud rate score.
requirements.behavior_spec: Merchant model maintains merchant categories and risk scoring attributes.

requirements.title: Device Entity Schema & Hardware Fingerprinting
requirements.srs_description: DS-5: Device entity schema with OS and hardware fingerprinting.
requirements.behavior_spec: Device model captures client OS, user agent, and fingerprint identifiers.

requirements.title: Location Entity Schema & Geo-Coordinate Mapping
requirements.srs_description: DS-6: Location entity schema with latitude/longitude geo coordinates.
requirements.behavior_spec: Location model maps transactions to physical geography and country boundaries.

requirements.title: Investigation Entity Schema & Workflow State Machine
requirements.srs_description: DS-7: Investigation model schema and status lifecycle transitions.
requirements.behavior_spec: Investigation model manages state transitions from QUEUED to COMPLETED/ESCALATED.

requirements.title: Evidence Entity Schema & Source Snippet Linkage
requirements.srs_description: DS-8: Evidence model schema and investigation foreign key relationship.
requirements.behavior_spec: Evidence model stores serialized evidence snippets linked to parent investigation.

requirements.title: FraudCase Entity Schema & Verdict Confidence Ratings
requirements.srs_description: DS-9: FraudCase model schema with verdict and confidence ratings.
requirements.behavior_spec: FraudCase model records final fraud determinations and confidence metrics.

requirements.title: RiskScore Entity Schema & Multi-Engine Metric Storage
requirements.srs_description: DS-10: RiskScore model schema with rule-based and ML model score breakdown.
requirements.behavior_spec: RiskScore model records rule engine scores and ML model scores side-by-side.

requirements.title: AuditLog Entity Schema & Tamper-Evident Chaining
requirements.srs_description: DS-11: AuditLog entity with cryptographic hash chaining fields.
requirements.behavior_spec: AuditLog model tracks execution events with SHA-256 hash chaining.

requirements.title: DeadLetterJob Entity Schema & Exhausted Retry Retention
requirements.srs_description: DS-12: DeadLetterJob entity schema for capturing exhausted retry jobs.
requirements.behavior_spec: DeadLetterJob model stores failed job payloads and stack traces for dead-letter analysis.

requirements.title: EvidenceVaultItem Entity Schema & SHA-256 Integrity Verification
requirements.srs_description: DS-13: EvidenceVaultItem model schema with SHA-256 digital vault digest.

requirements.title: ReportRecord Entity Schema & Regulatory Dossier Export
requirements.srs_description: DS-14: ReportRecord regulatory export model schema and formatting.
requirements.behavior_spec: ReportRecord model persists exported PDF/SAR dossiers and generation metadata.

requirements.title: PromptRecord Entity Schema & Dynamic AI Prompt Versioning
requirements.srs_description: DS-15: PromptRecord model schema for versioned AI prompt management.
requirements.behavior_spec: PromptRecord model enables multi-tenant prompt template versioning and runtime activation.

requirements.title: Checkpoint Database Reconnection & Resiliency
requirements.srs_description: OP-5: Checkpoint database schema re-initialization and reconnection resiliency.
requirements.behavior_spec: Handles database schema initialization and connection drops without corrupting storage.

requirements.behavior_spec: Gracefully switches between Redis Stream broker and in-memory queue.

requirements.srs_description: OP-9: Dead-letter queue routing upon exceeding maximum retry budget.
requirements.behavior_spec: Moves jobs exceeding retry budget (3 attempts) to DeadLetterJob store.

requirements.title: LangGraph State Machine Compilation & Entry Point
requirements.srs_description: LG-1: LangGraph compilation with planner as entry point.
requirements.behavior_spec: LangGraph state machine initializes and sets entry point to planner node.

requirements.title: Dynamic Conditional Task Fan-Out From Planner
requirements.srs_description: LG-2: Dynamic conditional edge fan-out from planner based on decomposed tasks.
requirements.behavior_spec: Routes planner execution to only the sub-tasks dynamically requested.

requirements.title: Parallel Retrieval Stream Fan-In to Evidence Verifier
requirements.srs_description: LG-3: Parallel evidence retrieval branches converge at evidence verifier.
requirements.behavior_spec: All retrieval branches converge at evidence verifier prior to risk analysis.

requirements.title: Sequential Reasoning Pipeline Chaining
requirements.srs_description: LG-4: Sequential pipeline chaining from velocity analysis to risk reasoning.
requirements.behavior_spec: Strictly chains execution order: verifier -> velocity -> rules -> knowledge -> reasoning.

requirements.title: Critic Reflection Feedback Loop to Validator
requirements.srs_description: LG-5: Critic node feeds evaluation feedback into validator routing.
requirements.behavior_spec: Critic feedback is routed into validator to guide correction and escalation.

requirements.title: Validator Conditional Routing Branch
requirements.srs_description: LG-6: Validator conditional branching based on evidence grounding status.
requirements.behavior_spec: Branches to report_generator if grounded and confident, or initiates retry/escalation.

requirements.title: Targeted Retry Routing to Failed Evidence Source
requirements.srs_description: LG-7: Failed evidence retrieval nodes trigger targeted retry routing.
requirements.behavior_spec: Re-routes execution directly to failed retrieval nodes rather than restarting full graph.

requirements.title: Bounded Critic Cycle Limit Escalation
requirements.srs_description: LG-8: Exceeding maximum critic correction cycles escalates to human review.
requirements.behavior_spec: Escalates to human_review if critic detects issues after 2 retry cycles.

requirements.title: Low Confidence Score Human Escalation Branch
requirements.srs_description: LG-9: Low confidence score below threshold triggers human review escalation.
requirements.behavior_spec: Transitions to human_review when confidence falls below 0.85 threshold.

requirements.title: Terminal State Graph Completion to END
requirements.srs_description: LG-10: Terminal nodes transition deterministically to graph completion END.
requirements.behavior_spec: report_generator and human_review terminal nodes route directly to END.
